documents.content: HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause.

args.reason: Need a method to separate an HTTP 200 order read from a COMPLETED lifecycle state before assessing whether a callback is due.
Start with the bound order's current lifecycle state; a 200 read alone cannot establish completion or callback timing.
Order is COMPLETED (v2), so the correlated callback event is now due; need its current event version and actual transport acknowledgement/failure.
Order is COMPLETED and delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202; ACK does not prove downstream processing, so verify receiver processing state.
